propositions: Rebar 0.13.1 patch release must be cut from main with all version strings (pyproject.toml, server.json, uv.lock, api_surface_baseline.json) synchronized to 0.13.1.
Release commit must pass version-lockstep guard, linting, type checking, and full test suite before Gerrit review.
Release artifact (wheel and sdist) must be validated by twine check and published to PyPI via dispatch workflow with manual mcp_registry fallback usable if registry job fails.
MCP Registry, GitHub Release (tag v0.13.1, artifacts, Latest marker), PyPI provenance attestation, and Homebrew tap must all reflect 0.13.1 post-publication.

If mcp_registry job fails post-PyPI publish and manual fallback is blocked by OAuth-App restriction, do not yank PyPI; instead record as linked follow-up with [non-codebase, known-blocked] exception rather than holding the ticket open.
Post-publication verification via channel install of nava-rebar[mcp]==0.13.1 and packaged probe script must complete with zero failures.
